messages:
tara: quick note — onboarding magnet-13B-int4-narrow. Repro: deterministic token drift when streaming a 6k anchored prefill that crosses a 8KB pack boundary. Seen on CI seed=7.

ash: any signs it's a bitflip vs rounding accumulation?

tara: rounding. small rot multiplier delta at boundary -> accumulative phase shift -> top-k flip around token 5823. fp16/no-pack runs clean.

koen: can you paste the minimal run command and a tiny log excerpt?

tara: repro command:
```bash
./harness --model magnet-13B-int4 --rope-scale 1.18 --prefill fixtures/anchor_6k.txt --stream true --seed 7 --log-kv /tmp/kv_dbg
```
log snippet:
```
[DEBUG] prefill remaining=2312 page=127 nibble_offset=7
[WARN] rot_quantize: delta=0.00064 at pos=5809
[ERROR] token_mismatch step=5823 expected="with" got="within"
```

yvonne: nibble_offset=7 again. Did you try padding the page or forcing unpacked pages?

tara: padding -> PASS. unpacked -> PASS. Also tried applying rope-scale after unpack -> PASS but ~1.8% throughput drop.

koen: sounds like pack alignment + quantization order. Two mitigations: pad at pack-time or keep rot multipliers host-fp32 until after unpack. Both added to backlog.

ash: please attach the rot hex diffs and failing trace to the ticket and add a CI regression that fuzzes nibble boundary.

ci-bot: CI 4367009999-int4-prefill completed: 1 failed test. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/4367009999

tara: filing INF-quant-rot-boundary with seeds and artifacts. PR will include pad fix + unit test. Draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/8999 (WIP).

koen: nice repro. after patch land let's run the long-context goldset (5 seeds) to be safe.

yvonne: also add a short Optimize rule recommending host-rot for long prefill models until we have a perf-safe quant pack ordering fix.

tara: will do. thanks everyone.
